notes: The COM document — the largest in the corpus — at requirement density: six fully self-contained requirements, five plain and one titled. SWS_Com_00346 is the titled 'Definition of configurable interface' variant whose body is a service table, and every requirement on the page carries the same upstream (SRS_Com_02037). SWS_Com_00719 names the cross-module symbol PduR_ComTransmit; ComIPduCallout, ComIPduDirection and ComIPduTriggerTransmitCallout appear throughout but are configuration parameters, not Com_* symbols, and must not be extracted. Two paragraphs of running prose between SWS_Com_00346 and SWS_Com_00381 contain no bracketed ids and no ceiling — plain text, not requirements. requirements.text: The AUTOSAR COM module shall forward all data of the received I-PDU (i.e. the complete I-PDU as provided by the PduR) in the Com_RxIpduCallout.

requirements.title: Definition of configurable interface Com_TxIpduCallout
requirements.text: Service Name Com_TxIpduCallout Syntax boolean Com_TxIpduCallout ( PduIdType PduId, PduInfoType* PduInfoPtr ) Service ID [hex] 0x29 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy don’t care Parameters (in) PduId ID of the transmitted I-PDU. Parameters (inout) PduInfoPtr Contains the length (SduLength) of the transmitted I-PDU and a pointer to the data of the I-PDU (SduDataPtr). Parameters (out) None Return value boolean true: I-PDU will be processed normal false: I-PDU will not be processed any further Description The I-PDU callout on sender side can be configured for example to implement user-defined transmission filtering or user-defined pre-transmission-processing of the outgoing I-PDU. Available via Configuration parameter ComUserCbkHeaderFile

The AUTOSAR COM module shall not support that other AUTOSAR COM module’s APIs than Com_TriggerIPDUSend, Com_TriggerIPDUSendWithMetaData, Com_SendSignal and Com_SendSignalGroup can be called out of an I-PDU callout.

In case ComIPduTriggerTransmitCallout is configured for an I-PDU and the I-PDU is started, the AUTOSAR COM module shall invoke this IPDU callout within every execution of Com_TriggerTransmit for this I-PDU.
When Com_TriggerTransmit is called, the AUTOSAR COM module shall ignore the return value from the ComIPduTriggerTransmitCallout.

In case a ComIPduCallout is configured for an I-PDU with ComIPduDirection configured to SEND, the AUTOSAR COM module shall invoke this I-PDU callout directly before the I-PDU is transmitted via PduR_ComTransmit.
